notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Crab enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
